parameters.description_en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the video device belongs.

You can view information about all products under the current instance on the **Products** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product) or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:

您可以在[物联网平台控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product)的**产品**页面或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)接口，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the video device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation to query the device ID.

><notice> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device that corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:

></notice>
